answer: Each applicant files a price quote for a meadow hay lot, locks a 70-credit bond and pays a fee. Jetty market publishes the clearing price; an auditor burns the bond for a quote over 5 percent away, and burns quotes sharing one source hash. The first filing costs 24 credits; the kth costs 24+6(k-1), so the 1000th costs 6018 and 1000 fakes pay 3,021,000 in fees plus 70,000 locked bonds, no batch discount. A rented-quote ring fails because copied quotes share one source hash. An honest grower from one garden plot files once, pays 24, and recovers the bond after a clean epoch.
